title: Add compile-time check: METHOD_ROLES keys match registered handlers
description:
What: Add a #[test] to kith-jmap that asserts METHOD_ROLES.len() == the number of handlers registered in Dispatcher::new(), and that every key in METHOD_ROLES appears in the registered handler set.

Algorithm:
1. Read kith-jmap/src/dispatch.rs to find Dispatcher::new() and METHOD_ROLES definition
2. Add test fn method_roles_matches_registered_handlers():
   - Build a Dispatcher (or call its register path)
   - Collect the set of registered method names
   - Assert METHOD_ROLES.len() == registered.len()
   - For each key in METHOD_ROLES, assert it appears in registered set
3. Test should fail at compile time or test time if anyone adds a handler without adding a role entry

Defensive programming rules:
- Test must not depend on count of methods hardcoded — it must compare the two sets dynamically
- If Dispatcher does not expose its handler names, add a pub(crate) fn handler_names() -> Vec<&str> method limited to #[cfg(test)]
- Do not change the production dispatch path

Agent team: single R+I+T agent (kith-jmap only)

Tests:
- cargo test -p kith-jmap method_roles_matches passes
- Manually verify the test fails if you add a bogus entry to METHOD_ROLES with no matching handler
